Reduce actual local feedback trajectories with incommensurate expansion scales to the known irrational-rotation two-coloring obstruction. Record the exact scope, directly checked source versions and errata, and the unresolved all-feedback sampling threshold. Keep the numerical bounds separate from this realization counterexample; no Q1 upgrade or general minimax claim. Preserve all earlier proofs, original manuscript, candidate, and submission drafts.

R02: prove expanding-control stability and exclude continuous common factors

Extend the fixed-period all-Borel value proof to finite continuous control enlargements with uniform separation. Prove that a different expansion rate eliminates every nonconstant continuous common state factor at every fixed period, and record the folded-branch boundary. Keep the existing integer optimizer and classical geometric methods explicit; no claim of Q1 readiness or a general minimax resolution. Preserve the original, manuscript, submission drafts, and all prior evidence.

R02: prove the integer affine full-feedback values and assess stage-one limits

Append a complete fixed-period, all-Borel proof for redundant integer affine controls using actual absorbing feedback trajectories and uniform finite-window counts. Record the common mod-one factor and classic volume/coding limits, without claiming Q1 readiness or a general minimax resolution. Adopt the staged research goals, pause submission preparation, and preserve the manuscript, submission drafts, original, and all prior R01/R02 evidence.

R02: refine submission materials and record remaining author gaps

Verify the journal's editable-source and numbered-citation requirements, clarify the cover letter's fixed-period full-Borel scope, and recover documented AI uses without inventing model versions or human author approval. Append verification section 22 and keep unconfirmed author information explicit. Preserve the manuscript, PDF, original, and research history; no submission or new mathematical claims.

R02: prepare Topology and its Applications submission materials

Add an English cover-letter draft, author-declaration draft, and concise submission checklist. Record verified official requirements and the remaining full-guide access gap without inventing author attestations. Preserve the nine-page manuscript, original, and R01/R02 history; no submission or new mathematical work.

R02: assess closed-cover contribution and draft focused submission candidate

Clarify prior common-threshold results of Huang-Maass-Ye and Kerr-Li. Organize the complete closed-cover Borel sampling formula, fixed-period control application, and feedback-dependent boundary in a nine-page TeX/PDF candidate. Preserve the original and all R01/R02 history; keep general and paused problems unresolved.
